# NemlAI plugin for Claude Code

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_agent_packages.py in the NemlAI repo; edit the sources there, not this file. -->

The `nemlai` skill and the NemlAI MCP server (`https://nemlai.milops.org/mcp`).

## Install

```text
/plugin marketplace add miller-milops/nemlai-mcp
/plugin install nemlai@nemlai
```

## Sign in

The server entry sends `Authorization: Bearer ${NEMLAI_TOKEN}`. Get a token once with the
`nemlai` CLI (`pipx install nemlai`, then `nemlai login`; it asks for your password in your own
terminal) and export it before starting Claude Code:

```bash
export NEMLAI_TOKEN=$(cat ~/.config/nemlai/token)
```

If `NEMLAI_TOKEN` is not set, Claude Code sends the text `Bearer ${NEMLAI_TOKEN}` unchanged, the
server answers 401 and the NemlAI tools stay unavailable. Claude Code does not fall back to OAuth
while the server has an `Authorization` header (`claude mcp list` says "OAuth fallback is disabled
when headers.Authorization is set"; checked with Claude Code 2.1.317). Set the variable and restart
Claude Code, or use OAuth with a server entry of your own instead:
`claude mcp add --transport http nemlai https://nemlai.milops.org/mcp`, then `/mcp` → nemlai → Authenticate.

Check: ask Claude "Hvem er jeg i NemlAI?"; the `whoami` tool shows your household.
